description_en: A group of fiveśikharatemples forming apańcadevalacomplex and dating from approximately 14th-15th century.The monuments are found in the northern part of the Bhurtī Temple Complex. The site itself is located in the northern end of the settlement of Bhurtī, 3 km north of Narayana, the district headquarters. It currently comprises 22 standingśikharatemples (ordevala) and one stone fountain. Architectural activity at the site can be situated between the 13thand 15thcentury, a time period corresponding to the latter part of the Khaśa Malla empire and the early phase of the Rāskoṭi dynasty (Andolfatto 2019,Pokharel 2011: 128-129,Sharma 1972: 23-31,Sharma 2012: 120-123).In 2008, the “Bhurti Temple Complex of Dailekh” was enlisted on UNESCO’s World Heritage Tentative List by the Government of Nepal (criteriaiiandiv).Thepañcadevalaplan is mostly found in the districts of Dailekh, Achham and Kalikot, which corresponds to the area controlled by the Rāskoṭi kings. This dynasty ruled between the end of the 14th century and the end of the 18th century. In the absence of epigraphic records it is possible to date the Bhurtī Pañcadevala 3 between the 14th and the 15th century.Thispańcadevalacomplex stands out amidst theśikharaarchitecture of the Karnali Basin for the carvings ornamenting the central temple's pediment (Skt.śukanāsikā). The pediment contains three horizontal registers comprising lions and decorative motifs. The horizontal registers are vertically dived in the middle. This separation is decorated with motifs of a spiral, a flower and a star.
description_ne: भुर्ती मन्दिर पसिरमा २२ शिखर मन्दिरहरू र एउटा ढुङ्गे धारा छन् । सन् २००८ मा यो मन्दिर परिसरलाई नेपाल सरकारले UNESCO’s World Heritage को ‘tentative list’ मा सूचीकृत गरेको थियो । यहाँ प्रस्तुत पञ्चदेवल पाँच वटा शिखर मन्दिरहरू एउटा समुह हो र यो देवल भुर्ती मन्दिर परिसरको उत्तर भागमा अवस्थित छ। यी मन्दिरहरू ईशाको चौधौंदेखि पन्ध्रौं शताब्दीमा निर्माण गरिएका हुनुपर्दछ । पञ्चदेवलको संरचना विशेष गरेर दैलेख, अछाम र कालीकोट जिल्लामा देख्न सकिन्छ जुन जिल्लाहरू मध्यकालमा रास्कोटी राजाहरूको नियन्त्रणमा थिए । रास्कोटी राजाहरूको राज्यकाल ईशाको चौधौं शताब्दीको अन्त्यदेखि अठारौं शताब्दीको अन्त्यसम्म लाई मानिन्छ ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths), Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired), Structural damages
